message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The defendant stole many motorcycles, other items, including military ammunition, weapons, etc. Crimes: theft (盗窃). Also illegal possession of firearms/ammunition? He stole military bullets, but not necessarily possession? He sold them. That could be illegal possession of ammunition, maybe illegal possession of firearms and ammunition (非法持有枪支、弹药). Also possibly illegal dealing in weapons (非法买卖枪支、弹药). However the main charge likely 盗窃 and 非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药. Also maybe 破坏易燃易爆设备? No. Also maybe 诈骗? No. Also maybe 盗窃数额巨大, could be 盗窃罪 plus 走私? Not. The items include military ammunition, which is a special crime: illegal possession of ammunition (非法持有、私藏军用弹药). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of illegal possession of firearms, ammunition, explosives (非法持有枪支、弹药、爆炸物罪). So include that.

Also there is theft of motor vehicles (摩托车) which is theft of motor vehicle (盗窃). Also theft of other goods (cash, etc). So main crimes: 盗窃;非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药.

Check examples: For similar case with gun, they answered "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药". So we use that.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃;非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药<eoa>
